facts.text: Serve the mains when the emperors throw their banquet.
facts.why: Senator Thraex hosts the party for the emperors. The emperors do not throw it. The same line is also the data cue.

vibe.verdict: A fair Roman tavern, but the card is mostly honey dishes and the poster image has big black bars across it.

Lucius reciting Virgil at Thraex's party
